Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files and renames them with [filename].[email].wallet extension
Ransomware encrypting files and demanding payment
Releases master decryption keys for previous variants when switching to new extension
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by Wallet Ransomware and Crysis family ransomware
Attack Vector: Infection via ransomware payload, files encrypted and renamed with ransom note email addresses
Indicators of Compromise: Pastebin post containing 198 master decryption keys
Known Wallet ransomware email addresses such as destroed_total@aol.com, age_empires@aol.com, etc.
Use of .onion extension in recent ransomware variants
